audience: merchants that take card payments with Yoco and need to check payments, payouts and refunds

useCases.title: Check recent card payments and their fees
useCases.text: List the card payments with their status, amount and fees. Open one payment to see its refunds and processing fees.

useCases.title: Match a bank deposit to its payouts
useCases.text: List the payouts to the bank account. Open one payout, then list its entries to match each payment, refund and fee to the deposit.

useCases.title: Find orders by status or location
useCases.text: List the orders filtered by status or location, with the locations of the business. Open one order to see its line items, taxes and discounts.

useCases.title: Review refunds from a period
useCases.text: List the refunds from a period with their status and amount. Open one refund to check its details.

useCases.title: Create a payment link for a deposit
useCases.text: Create a payment link for an amount in the smallest currency unit, such as cents for ZAR. The link is real and customers can pay it. Then list the payment links to see which are still pending.

useCases.title: Delete a payment link that is no longer valid
useCases.text: Open the payment link first to check its status. Then delete it, so customers can no longer pay it. Deletion cannot be undone.
